# Zach Collins
> Founder and developer of LightDeck, owner of Evening Glow, and U.S. Army veteran in Lexington, Kentucky.

## Work
- LightDeck: software for landscape-lighting contractors. JavaScript, Supabase/Postgres, and Vercel. Connects property photos, fixture plans, contractor-set pricing, and proposal preparation.
- Zach works across product requirements, application logic, database design, automated testing, and release verification. He uses AI development tools and focuses on validated model output, structured source data, and human review.
- Last documented beta scope, September 2026: closed, free, founder-supported beta for private field capture and proposal, PDF, and invoice drafts. Customer publishing, messages, payments, signatures, and generated night concepts were not enabled in that documented beta walkthrough.
- Evening Glow: outdoor lighting design and installation in Central Kentucky. Its field work informs LightDeck product decisions.

## Work with Zach
- Paid contractor workflow reviews for software and AI teams serving contractors, and service-business owners with a specific process to improve.
- Initial scope: one inquiry-to-quote workflow; deliverables are a process map, prioritized findings, a scope checklist and a handoff discussion.
- Scope and fee are agreed before work begins. Implementation is scoped separately.
- Contact: zc@eveningglowllc.com. For current LightDeck access information, visit the product website.
